top_findings.title: CORS configuration allows credentialed requests from all origins
top_findings.description: The FastAPI Application has a CORS policy which shares credentialed responses with all origins by setting the `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header to the wildcard `*` via the middleware field `allow_origins`. Furthermore, this is an invalid CORS configuration that will be rejected by many modern browsers.
top_findings.remediation: The FastAPI Application has a CORS policy which shares credentialed responses with all origins by setting the `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header to the wildcard `*` via the middleware field `allow_origins`. Furthermore, this is an invalid CORS configuration that will be rejected by many modern browsers.

sast_findings.title: Hard-coded secret
sast_findings.description: A secret, such as a password, cryptographic key, or token is stored in plaintext directly in the source code, in an application's properties, or configuration file. Users with access to the secret may then use the secret to access resources that they otherwise would not have access to. Secret type: `Secret (generic)`.
sast_findings.remediation: A secret, such as a password, cryptographic key, or token is stored in plaintext directly in the source code, in an application's properties, or configuration file. Users with access to the secret may then use the secret to access resources that they otherwise would not have access to.
